name: Postmark
description: Postmark transactional and broadcast email: send single, batch and templated emails, manage templates, search sent and inbound messages with opens, clicks and bounces, sending statistics, suppressions, message streams and webhooks; with an account token also servers, domains and sender signatures.
instructions:
## Postmark
This connector uses the **Postmark API** (`https://api.postmarkapp.com`) for transactional and broadcast email: sending single, batch and templated emails, templates, searching sent and received messages with opens and clicks, bounces, sending statistics, suppressions, message streams and webhooks of one Postmark **server**. With an optional account token it also reads the account's servers, domains and sender signatures.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. In Postmark open the server, then **API Tokens**, and copy a **Server API token** into `POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN`. It is sent as the `X-Postmark-Server-Token` header and gives access to that server only.
2. Optional: for the account tools (`postmark_list_servers`, `postmark_get_server_by_id`, `postmark_list_domains`, `postmark_get_domain`, `postmark_verify_domain_dkim`, `postmark_verify_domain_return_path`, `postmark_list_sender_signatures`, `postmark_get_sender_signature`) an account owner or admin copies the **Account API token** from **Account**, **API Tokens** into `POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN`. It is sent as `X-Postmark-Account-Token` on those tools only. Without it they answer 401; the other tools work.
3. Run `postmark_get_server` to check the token.

**Sending**
- `postmark_send_email` for one email, `postmark_send_batch` for up to 500 different emails, `postmark_send_email_with_template` and `postmark_send_batch_with_templates` for stored templates with a `TemplateModel`.
- `From` must be a confirmed sender signature or an address on a verified domain. New accounts are in test mode until Postmark approves them and can only send to addresses on their own domain.
- Transactional email goes through the `outbound` stream (the default). Bulk or marketing email must use a Broadcasts stream (`MessageStream`), which adds unsubscribe handling.
- Every send reaches real inboxes: show the user the recipients, subject and content and wait for a yes. Batch calls answer 200 even when single messages fail: check `ErrorCode` (0 = accepted) and `Message` of each result.

**Templates**: `postmark_list_templates`, `postmark_get_template`, `postmark_validate_template` (check syntax and render a preview), `postmark_create_template`, `postmark_update_template`, `postmark_delete_template`. Variables use Mustachio, e.g. `{{name}}`; a Layout wraps standard templates with `{{{@content}}}`.

**Finding what happened to an email**
1. `postmark_search_outbound_messages` by recipient, tag, subject or date, or `postmark_search_inbound_messages` for received mail; `postmark_retry_inbound_message` reposts a failed inbound message to the webhook.
2. `postmark_get_outbound_message` (or `postmark_get_inbound_message`) shows the details and the `MessageEvents` timeline (Delivered, Bounced, Opened, LinkClicked, SubscriptionChanged).
3. Opens and clicks: `postmark_list_message_opens`, `postmark_get_message_opens`, `postmark_list_message_clicks`, `postmark_get_message_clicks`.
4. Bounces: `postmark_get_delivery_stats`, `postmark_list_bounces`, `postmark_get_bounce`, `postmark_get_bounce_dump` (raw SMTP answer). `postmark_activate_bounce` reactivates an address when `CanActivate` is true.
5. Suppressions per stream: `postmark_list_suppressions`, `postmark_create_suppressions`, `postmark_delete_suppressions` (spam complaints cannot be removed).

**Statistics**: `postmark_get_outbound_overview` for totals and rates of a period, `postmark_get_outbound_stats` with `metric` for daily counts (sends, bounces, spam, tracked, opens, clicks, platforms, email clients, browsers, locations).

**Server setup**: `postmark_get_server`; streams with `postmark_list_message_streams`, `postmark_get_message_stream`, `postmark_create_message_stream`, `postmark_update_message_stream`, `postmark_archive_message_stream`, `postmark_unarchive_message_stream`; webhooks with `postmark_list_webhooks`, `postmark_get_webhook`, `postmark_create_webhook`, `postmark_update_webhook`, `postmark_delete_webhook`. Domain DNS checks need the account token (see Setup).

**Reading the answers**: field names are PascalCase (`MessageID`, `SubmittedAt`, `TotalCount`). Search dates (`fromdate`, `todate`) are US Eastern Time; returned timestamps carry their offset. Statistics dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Messages and their events are kept for the server's retention period (45 days by default).

**Paging**: list and search tools take `count` (default 50, at most 500) and `offset`; `count + offset` may not exceed 10,000. Narrow the date range to go further back. Compare `TotalCount` with what you received to know whether more pages exist.

**Errors**: 401 means a missing or wrong token (or a server token on an account tool), 422 an invalid request: read `ErrorCode` and `Message` (300 send validation such as an invalid address or missing body, 406 inactive or suppressed recipient, 410 more than 500 messages in a batch, 412 recipients outside the From domain while the account awaits approval, 1101 template not found, 1235 unknown message stream). 429 means too many requests; 500 a Postmark problem, retry later.

**Switched off at install**: `postmark_delete_template`, `postmark_delete_suppressions`, `postmark_delete_webhook` and `postmark_archive_message_stream`; an admin switches them on when the team needs them.
prerequisites: A Postmark account with a server and its Server API token; the Account API token is optional and only needed for the account tools.

POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.label: Server API token
POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.help: Postmark, your server, API Tokens: the Server API token. It reaches that one server.
POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.patternMessage: A Postmark token looks like a UUID: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters.

POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.label: Account API token (optional)
POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.help: Postmark, Account, API Tokens (account owners and admins only). Needed only for the server, domain and sender signature tools; leave empty otherwise.
POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.patternMessage: A Postmark token looks like a UUID: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters.

verifyHints.401: Postmark refused the token. Copy the Server API token again from your server's API Tokens tab; the account tools need POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN instead.
verifyHints.422: Postmark rejected the request. Read ErrorCode and Message in the answer: 300 is a send validation error (address, body, limits), 406 an inactive recipient, 412 an account still pending approval.

tools.name: postmark_send_email
tools.description: Send one email through the server: from a confirmed sender, to up to 50 recipients, with subject, HTML and/or text body, tag, metadata, tracking and attachments. Returns the MessageID.

From.description: Sender address of a confirmed sender signature or verified domain; "Name <sender@example.com>" adds a display name.

To.description: Recipient addresses, comma-separated (To, Cc and Bcc together at most 50).

Tag.description: One tag to group the email in statistics and searches, e.g. password-reset.

TrackOpens.description: Track opens for this email (needs an HTML body).

TrackLinks.description: Link tracking: None, HtmlAndText, HtmlOnly or TextOnly.

Metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs stored with the message and returned in webhooks, e.g. {"order_id": "123"}.

Attachments.description: Attachments: [{"Name": "invoice.pdf", "Content": "<base64>", "ContentType": "application/pdf"}]; ContentID "cid:logo.png" for inline images. 10 MB total.

MessageStream.description: Message stream to send through: outbound (default, transactional) or a broadcast stream id for bulk mail.

HtmlBody.description: HTML body; HtmlBody or TextBody is required.

TextBody.description: Plain text body; HtmlBody or TextBody is required.

tools.name: postmark_send_batch
tools.description: Send up to 500 different emails in one call; each message takes the same fields as postmark_send_email. Returns one result per message with its own ErrorCode (0 = accepted).

tools.name: postmark_send_email_with_template
tools.description: Send one email built from a stored template: pass TemplateId or TemplateAlias and the TemplateModel with the variables. Subject and body come from the template.

From.description: Sender address of a confirmed sender signature or verified domain; "Name <sender@example.com>" adds a display name.

To.description: Recipient addresses, comma-separated (To, Cc and Bcc together at most 50).

Tag.description: One tag to group the email in statistics and searches, e.g. password-reset.

TrackOpens.description: Track opens for this email (needs an HTML body).

TrackLinks.description: Link tracking: None, HtmlAndText, HtmlOnly or TextOnly.

Metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs stored with the message and returned in webhooks, e.g. {"order_id": "123"}.

Attachments.description: Attachments: [{"Name": "invoice.pdf", "Content": "<base64>", "ContentType": "application/pdf"}]; ContentID "cid:logo.png" for inline images. 10 MB total.

MessageStream.description: Message stream to send through: outbound (default, transactional) or a broadcast stream id for bulk mail.

TemplateId.description: Template id; give TemplateId or TemplateAlias.

TemplateAlias.description: Template alias, e.g. welcome; give TemplateId or TemplateAlias.

TemplateModel.description: Values for the template variables, e.g. {"name": "Ana", "action_url": "https://..."}.

InlineCss.description: Inline the template CSS into the HTML (default true).

tools.name: postmark_send_batch_with_templates
tools.description: Send up to 500 templated emails in one call, each with its own template, recipient and model. Returns one result per message with its own ErrorCode.

tools.name: postmark_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates of the server with id, alias, name, type (Standard or Layout), active flag and layout. Templates are used with postmark_send_email_with_template.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

layout_template.description: Only standard templates that use this layout alias.

tools.name: postmark_get_template
tools.description: Get one template by id or alias: name, subject, HTML and text body with their Mustachio variables, type and layout.

tools.name: postmark_create_template
tools.description: Create a template (Standard, or Layout to wrap other templates) with name, alias, subject and HTML/text bodies using Mustachio variables. Validate first with postmark_validate_template.

Alias.description: Alias to send by, letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter.

Subject.description: Subject with optional {{variables}}; required for Standard templates, not allowed for Layouts.

HtmlBody.description: HTML body; a Layout must contain {{{@content}}}.

LayoutTemplate.description: Alias of the layout to wrap this standard template in.

tools.name: postmark_update_template
tools.description: Edit a template by id or alias: name, alias, subject, bodies or layout. Only the fields passed change; the next send uses the new version.

Alias.description: Alias to send by, letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter.

Subject.description: Subject with optional {{variables}}; required for Standard templates, not allowed for Layouts.

HtmlBody.description: HTML body; a Layout must contain {{{@content}}}.

LayoutTemplate.description: Alias of the layout to wrap this standard template in.

tools.name: postmark_delete_template
tools.description: Delete a template for good by id or alias. A layout cannot be deleted while standard templates still use it. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: postmark_validate_template
tools.description: Check template content without saving: Mustachio syntax errors, the variables it uses and a rendered preview with a test model.

TestRenderModel.description: Example values to render with, e.g. {"name": "Ana"}.

InlineCssForHtmlTestRender.description: Inline CSS in the rendered HTML (default true).

LayoutTemplate.description: Layout alias to render the standard template in.

tools.name: postmark_search_outbound_messages
tools.description: Search sent messages (last 45 days by default retention) by recipient, sender, tag, subject, status, stream, date range or one metadata field. Returns TotalCount and Messages with MessageID, status and recipients.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

status.description: queued or sent (sent and processed are the same).

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

fromdate.description: From this date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00 (US Eastern Time).

todate.description: Up to this date or date-time, inclusive (US Eastern Time).

tools.name: postmark_get_outbound_message
tools.description: Details of one sent message by MessageID: recipients, subject, bodies, tag, metadata and the MessageEvents timeline (delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, ...).

message_id.description: MessageID from a send result or a search.

tools.name: postmark_search_inbound_messages
tools.description: Search inbound messages received by the server by recipient, sender, subject, mailbox hash, tag, status or date range.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

mailboxhash.description: Mailbox hash (the part after + in the inbound address).

status.description: blocked, processed (default), queued, failed or scheduled.

fromdate.description: From this date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00 (US Eastern Time).

todate.description: Up to this date or date-time, inclusive (US Eastern Time).

tools.name: postmark_get_inbound_message
tools.description: Details of one inbound message: sender, recipients, subject, text and HTML body, headers, attachments list, status and the webhook processing result.

tools.name: postmark_retry_inbound_message
tools.description: Retry posting a failed inbound message to the server's inbound webhook, e.g. after fixing the endpoint.

message_id.description: MessageID of a failed inbound message.

tools.name: postmark_list_message_opens
tools.description: List open events across messages with recipient, time, email client, OS, platform and location. Filter by recipient, tag, stream, client or location.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

client_family.description: Email client family, e.g. Gmail or Outlook.

platform.description: Platform: Desktop, Mobile, WebMail or Unknown.

tools.name: postmark_get_message_opens
tools.description: List the open events of one message: each open with time, client, OS, platform and location.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

tools.name: postmark_list_message_clicks
tools.description: List link click events across messages with recipient, clicked URL, time, browser, OS, platform and location. Filter by recipient, tag, stream, client or location.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

client_family.description: Email client family, e.g. Gmail or Outlook.

platform.description: Platform: Desktop, Mobile, WebMail or Unknown.

tools.name: postmark_get_message_clicks
tools.description: List the link click events of one message: each click with the original link, time, browser, OS and location.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

tools.name: postmark_get_delivery_stats
tools.description: Bounce summary of the server: number of inactive (deactivated) addresses and the count of bounces per bounce type.

tools.name: postmark_list_bounces
tools.description: List bounces with type, recipient, description, details, whether the address is now inactive and whether it can be activated. Filter by type, address, tag, message, stream or date.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

inactive.description: true: only bounces that deactivated the address; false: only those that did not.

email_filter.description: Recipient address or part of it.

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

fromdate.description: From this date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00 (US Eastern Time).

todate.description: Up to this date or date-time, inclusive (US Eastern Time).

tools.name: postmark_get_bounce
tools.description: Get one bounce by id: type, recipient, description, SMTP details, the related MessageID, Inactive and CanActivate flags.

tools.name: postmark_get_bounce_dump
tools.description: Get the raw SMTP source of a bounce message (kept for 30 days), to read the receiving server's exact answer.

tools.name: postmark_activate_bounce
tools.description: Reactivate an address deactivated by a bounce so it can receive email again. Only when CanActivate is true; spam complaints cannot be activated. Confirm the address with the user.

tools.name: postmark_get_outbound_overview
tools.description: Sending overview for a period: sent, bounced, spam complaints, bounce and spam rates, opens, unique opens, tracked emails and link clicks.

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_get_outbound_stats
tools.description: Daily counts of one metric for a period: sends, bounces (by type), spam, tracked, opens, opens by platform or email client, clicks, clicks by browser, platform or location.

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_list_suppressions
tools.description: List suppressed addresses of a message stream (no email is sent to them) with the reason (HardBounce, SpamComplaint, ManualSuppression), origin and date.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

origin.description: How it was added: Recipient, Customer or Admin.

tools.name: postmark_create_suppressions
tools.description: Suppress up to 50 addresses in a message stream so nothing is sent to them any more (ManualSuppression). Returns a status per address.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_delete_suppressions
tools.description: Remove up to 50 addresses from the suppression list of a stream so they can receive email again. SpamComplaint suppressions cannot be removed. Confirm with the user first.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_list_message_streams
tools.description: List the message streams of the server (Transactional, Broadcasts, Inbound) with id, name, description, unsubscribe handling and archive state.

tools.name: postmark_get_message_stream
tools.description: Get one message stream by id: name, type, description, unsubscribe handling, created, updated and archived dates.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_create_message_stream
tools.description: Create a message stream: Transactional for app email or Broadcasts for bulk and marketing mail (at most 10 streams per server, one Inbound).

ID.description: Stream id, lower case letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. newsletter.

MessageStreamType.description: Transactional or Broadcasts (Inbound exists once per server).

SubscriptionManagementConfiguration.description: Unsubscribe handling: {"UnsubscribeHandlingType": "Postmark"}; Postmark (default for Broadcasts), Custom or None (Transactional and Inbound).

tools.name: postmark_update_message_stream
tools.description: Edit a message stream: name, description or unsubscribe handling. The id and type cannot change.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

SubscriptionManagementConfiguration.description: Unsubscribe handling: {"UnsubscribeHandlingType": "Postmark"}; Postmark (default for Broadcasts), Custom or None (Transactional and Inbound).

tools.name: postmark_archive_message_stream
tools.description: Archive a message stream: it stops sending and is deleted with its data after 45 days unless restored with postmark_unarchive_message_stream. Default streams cannot be archived.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_unarchive_message_stream
tools.description: Restore an archived message stream within 45 days of archiving so it can send again.

stream_id.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of the server with URL, stream, HTTP auth and headers, and which events trigger them (Open, Click, Delivery, Bounce, SpamComplaint, SubscriptionChange).

messagestream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook by id: URL, message stream, HTTP auth user, custom headers and enabled triggers.

tools.name: postmark_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook for a message stream: the URL and which events (opens, clicks, deliveries, bounces, spam complaints, subscription changes) to post to it.

Url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the POSTs.

Triggers.description: Events: {"Open": {"Enabled": true, "PostFirstOpenOnly": false}, "Click": {"Enabled": true}, "Delivery": {"Enabled": true}, "Bounce": {"Enabled": true, "IncludeContent": false}, "SpamComplaint": {"Enabled": true, "IncludeContent": false}, "SubscriptionChange": {"Enabled": true}}.

Verify.description: Test the endpoint for each enabled event before saving (default true).

MessageStream.description: Message stream id, e.g. outbound (default transactional stream), broadcast or your own stream id from postmark_list_message_streams.

tools.name: postmark_update_webhook
tools.description: Edit a webhook: URL, HTTP auth, headers or triggers. Triggers left out keep their setting.

Url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the POSTs.

Triggers.description: Events: {"Open": {"Enabled": true, "PostFirstOpenOnly": false}, "Click": {"Enabled": true}, "Delivery": {"Enabled": true}, "Bounce": {"Enabled": true, "IncludeContent": false}, "SpamComplaint": {"Enabled": true, "IncludeContent": false}, "SubscriptionChange": {"Enabled": true}}.

Verify.description: Test the endpoint for each enabled event before saving (default true).

tools.name: postmark_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook; Postmark stops posting those events to its URL. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: postmark_get_server
tools.description: Settings of the server the token belongs to: id, name, color, inbound address and domain, tracking defaults, hook URLs and SMTP API state. Needs no ids; checks the token.

tools.name: postmark_list_servers
tools.description: List all servers of the account with id, name, color, API tokens and settings. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

name.description: Only servers whose name contains this text.

tools.name: postmark_get_server_by_id
tools.description: Get one server of the account by id with its settings and API tokens. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

tools.name: postmark_list_domains
tools.description: List the sending domains of the account with DKIM, Return-Path and SPF verification state. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

tools.name: postmark_get_domain
tools.description: Get one domain with the DNS records to set (DKIM host and value, pending DKIM, Return-Path CNAME) and their verification state. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

tools.name: postmark_verify_domain_dkim
tools.description: Ask Postmark to check the DKIM DNS record of a domain now, after the user has added it. Returns the domain with DKIMVerified. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

tools.name: postmark_verify_domain_return_path
tools.description: Ask Postmark to check the Return-Path CNAME of a domain now. Returns the domain with ReturnPathDomainVerified. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

tools.name: postmark_list_sender_signatures
tools.description: List the sender signatures (single confirmed From addresses) of the account with confirmation and DKIM state. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

offset.description: Items to skip; count + offset may not exceed 10,000.

tools.name: postmark_get_sender_signature
tools.description: Get one sender signature: From address, name, reply-to, confirmed flag, domain and DNS verification details. Needs POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.
